environment: Organization: Committed Contracting / HomeBench (Rich Fischer). Primary use: software development of the HomeBench Pro web app (Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase).
Source control: github.com/rich530 and every repo under it. Pull requests and auto-merge (gh pr merge --auto --squash) into main of rich530/homebench are routine; main deploys only to staging.
Cloud provider(s): Supabase (hosted Postgres) and Vercel (hosting). Local development uses the Supabase CLI running in Docker on this machine (localhost ports 54321 to 54324).
Trusted internal domains: localhost, 127.0.0.1, registry.npmjs.org, *.vercel.app preview URLs for rich530/homebench branches, api.github.com, github.com/rich530.
Key internal services: GitHub Actions for rich530/homebench (CI, staging-migrate, prod-migrate workflows), Vercel project homebench, Supabase local stack.

Sensitive remote targets: the Supabase project homebench-prod, the Supabase project homebench-staging, the Vercel production deployment, and the git branch named production. The agent never connects to either hosted Supabase project; CI does.
Sensitive data locations & audiences: customer names, phones, emails, and addresses in any hosted database; files under data/private in the repo (Rich only, never committed, never sent anywhere).

Additional context: multi-tenant contractor software; production credentials never exist on this machine; test and sandbox credentials for Stripe, Twilio, Resend, Intuit, Hover, MagicPlan may be used only against their test or sandbox endpoints.
allow: Running the local Supabase stack (supabase start, stop, status, db reset without --linked or --db-url, migration new, gen types --local) is allowed: it only touches Docker containers on this machine.
Installing npm packages from registry.npmjs.org into the repo is allowed.
Creating pull requests and enabling auto-merge with gh pr merge --auto --squash on rich530/homebench is allowed: branch protection requires green CI and main only deploys to staging.
